items.q: In the membrane cell, the products at the cathode are:
items.qAf: In die membraansel is die produkte by die katode:
items.explain: Water is reduced at the cathode: 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂ + 2OH⁻.
items.explainAf: Water word by die katode gereduseer: 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂ + 2OH⁻.

items.q: Which ions pass through the membrane in the chlor-alkali cell?
items.qAf: Watter ione gaan deur die membraan in die chloor-alkali-sel?
items.explain: The membrane lets only Na⁺ (cations) through to the cathode side.
items.explainAf: Die membraan laat net Na⁺ (katione) deur na die katodekant.

items.q: Why must chlorine be kept apart from the sodium hydroxide in the cell?
items.qAf: Waarom moet chloor in die sel van die natriumhidroksied geskei word?
options: They react, making the NaOH impure
optionsAf: Hulle reageer, wat die NaOH onsuiwer maak
items.explain: Cl₂ reacts with NaOH (forming bleach), so the membrane keeps them apart.
items.explainAf: Cl₂ reageer met NaOH (en vorm bleikmiddel), dus hou die membraan hulle apart.

items.q: In the electrolytic refining of copper, the impure copper is the:
items.qAf: By die elektrolitiese raffinering van koper is die onsuiwer koper die:
items.explain: Copper is oxidised from the impure anode and deposited on the pure cathode.
items.explainAf: Koper word uit die onsuiwer anode geoksideer en op die suiwer katode neergeslaan.

items.q: During copper refining, the concentration of Cu²⁺ in the electrolyte:
items.qAf: Tydens koperraffinering sal die konsentrasie Cu²⁺ in die elektroliet:
items.explain: Cu²⁺ is produced at the anode as fast as it is used at the cathode.
items.explainAf: Cu²⁺ word by die anode net so vinnig gevorm as wat dit by die katode gebruik word.

items.q: In aluminium extraction, the carbon anodes must be replaced regularly because:
items.qAf: By aluminiumontginning moet die koolstofanodes gereeld vervang word omdat:
options: oxygen formed at the anode reacts with the carbon
optionsAf: suurstof wat by die anode vorm met die koolstof reageer
items.explain: Hot oxygen reacts with the carbon to form CO₂, so the anodes burn away.
items.explainAf: Warm suurstof reageer met die koolstof om CO₂ te vorm, dus brand die anodes weg.

items.q: The industrial process that uses a cell with a membrane to make chlorine and sodium hydroxide from brine.
items.qAf: Die nywerheidsproses wat ’n sel met ’n membraan gebruik om chloor en natriumhidroksied uit pekel te maak.

items.q: A concentrated solution of sodium chloride in water.
items.qAf: ’n Gekonsentreerde oplossing van natriumchloried in water.

items.q: The ore from which aluminium is extracted.
items.qAf: Die erts waaruit aluminium onttrek word.

items.q: The substance added to alumina to lower its melting point in the extraction of aluminium.
items.qAf: Die stof wat by alumina gevoeg word om sy smeltpunt te verlaag tydens die onttrekking van aluminium.

items.q: In the chlor-alkali process, chlorine gas forms at the anode.
items.qAf: In die chloor-alkali-proses vorm chloorgas by die anode.
items.explain: True. Chloride ions are oxidised at the anode: 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻.
items.explainAf: Waar. Chloriedione word by die anode geoksideer: 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻.

items.q: The carbon anodes in aluminium extraction last forever.
items.qAf: Die koolstofanodes in aluminiumonttrekking hou vir altyd.
items.explain: False. They react with the oxygen formed and burn away to CO₂, so they must be replaced regularly.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Hulle reageer met die suurstof wat vorm en brand weg tot CO₂, dus moet hulle gereeld vervang word.

items.q: Explain why the extraction of aluminium uses so much electrical energy.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die onttrekking van aluminium soveel elektriese energie gebruik.
points: Aluminium is very reactive, so it can only be extracted by electrolysis.
A very large current is needed, and the electrolyte must be kept molten at a high temperature (about 950 °C).
pointsAf: Aluminium is baie reaktief, dus kan dit net deur elektrolise onttrek word.
’n Baie groot stroom is nodig, en die elektroliet moet gesmelt gehou word by ’n hoë temperatuur (omtrent 950 °C).
